payload.detail: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): Toast host still never mounted. Recount: 3 files use CopyButton and about 24 non-mockup .tsx files hand-roll 'Copied', not 35. A consistency recommendation, so P3. PRIOR DETAIL: grep -rn 'ui/toast' src returns nothing; on-call-copy-number.tsx:36-37 states it in a comment. 35 in-scope files implement their own copy confirmation against 2 using ui/copy-button.tsx, with four different wordings. The 2026-07-07 fix for single-slot notifications overwriting each other exists as a primitive but nothing mounts it. Copying a dose or citation is high-frequency here and the confirmation differs by mode.
